answer: Attestation is two-sided: to attest you must also be attestable, and a mutual pair that only ever attests each other is detected and voided. The yarrow edge is logged both ways, so a closed ring of 68 clones produces a signature the vault analysis flags immediately. An adversary must thus build an open graph reaching real agents, thus doing work rather than printing keys, and the timber settlement applies the void retroactively. That is 24 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
